import warnings
import pytest
import my_memviz


class MockTensor:
    def __init__(self, shape, dtype_name="float32", elem_size=4):
        self.shape = shape
        self._dtype_name = dtype_name
        self._elem_size = elem_size
        self.grad_fn = None

    def nelement(self):
        n = 1
        for s in self.shape:
            n *= s
        return n

    def element_size(self):
        return self._elem_size

    @property
    def dtype(self):
        return self._dtype_name


class AccumulateGrad:
    def __init__(self, variable):
        self.variable = variable
        self.next_functions = []


class MulBackward0:
    def __init__(self, next_functions, saved_mat=None):
        self.next_functions = next_functions
        if saved_mat is not None:
            self._saved_mat = saved_mat


class AddBackward0:
    def __init__(self, next_functions):
        self.next_functions = next_functions


class SubBackward0:
    def __init__(self, next_functions):
        self.next_functions = next_functions


def test_format_bytes_basic():
    assert my_memviz.format_bytes(0) == "0"
    assert my_memviz.format_bytes(1000) == "1,000"
    assert my_memviz.format_bytes(1048576) == "1,048,576"


def test_graph_add_node_accumulates_memory():
    graph = my_memviz.Graph()
    node1 = my_memviz.GraphNode(
        node_id=0, op_type="MulBackward0", output_shape=[2, 3],
        saved_tensors=[], saved_memory_bytes=100
    )
    node2 = my_memviz.GraphNode(
        node_id=1, op_type="AddBackward0", output_shape=[2, 3],
        saved_tensors=[], saved_memory_bytes=200
    )
    graph.add_node(node1)
    graph.add_node(node2)
    assert graph.total_saved_memory_bytes == 300
    assert len(graph.nodes) == 2


def test_extract_saved_tensors_with_saved_mat():
    saved_mat = MockTensor([2, 3])
    grad_fn = MulBackward0([], saved_mat=saved_mat)
    result = my_memviz.extract_saved_tensors(grad_fn)
    assert len(result) == 1
    assert result[0]["name"] == "mat"
    assert result[0]["shape"] == [2, 3]
    assert result[0]["dtype"] == "float32"
    assert result[0]["size_bytes"] == 24
    assert result[0]["size_formatted"] == "24"


def test_traverse_graph_simple_chain():
    input_tensor = MockTensor([2, 3])
    acc = AccumulateGrad(input_tensor)
    saved_mat = MockTensor([2, 3])
    mul = MulBackward0([(acc, 0)], saved_mat=saved_mat)
    output_tensor = MockTensor([2, 3])
    output_tensor.grad_fn = mul

    graph = my_memviz.Graph()
    my_memviz.traverse_graph(output_tensor, input_tensor, graph)

    assert len(graph.nodes) == 1
    assert graph.nodes[0].op_type == "MulBackward0"
    assert graph.nodes[0].output_shape == [2, 3]
    assert len(graph.nodes[0].saved_tensors) == 1
    assert graph.nodes[0].saved_tensors[0]["name"] == "mat"
    assert graph.nodes[0].saved_memory_bytes == 24
    assert graph.total_saved_memory_bytes == 24


def test_traverse_graph_longer_chain_with_edges():
    input_tensor = MockTensor([4, 5])
    acc = AccumulateGrad(input_tensor)
    sub = SubBackward0([(acc, 0)])
    mul = MulBackward0([(sub, 0)])
    add = AddBackward0([(mul, 0)])
    output_tensor = MockTensor([4, 5])
    output_tensor.grad_fn = add

    graph = my_memviz.Graph()
    my_memviz.traverse_graph(output_tensor, input_tensor, graph)

    assert len(graph.nodes) == 2
    assert graph.nodes[0].op_type == "AddBackward0"
    assert graph.nodes[1].op_type == "MulBackward0"
    assert len(graph.edges) == 1
    assert graph.edges[0] == {"from": 0, "to": 1}
    assert graph.total_saved_memory_bytes == 0
